fusions.name: Heavy Tread
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. A heavy blow that deals 6 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofrot Wave
fusions.desc: A wave of spores deals 30 damage to everything in a cone 8 tiles long, ignoring armour. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Saddle Salve
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds and 10 health.

fusions.name: Furrowed Track
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
